blog_summary: The blog post is an introductory post for 'The Morning Paper' blog, outlining Adrian Colyer's approach to paper selection and his goals for the year. He highlights the Lindy effect, emphasizing the importance of focusing on papers that have stood the test of time, as these are more likely to remain relevant. Colyer encourages readers to explore papers outside their immediate area of expertise, suggesting that cross-domain insights can spark innovation and new perspectives. He also shares his conference watch list for 2020, inviting recommendations for additional conferences or papers to cover.
